primary_intent: Louer une moto pour séjourner ou rouler à Hoan Kiem (centre autour du lac) : où prendre la moto, quand rouler, où se garer.

new_meta.description: Louer une moto pour le centre de Hanoi : retrait à Long Biên, heures creuses, interdiction des motos autour du lac le soir du week-end, stationnement.

evidence.FACTS: Removed 'règle du site / aucune adresse inventée' wording and the claim that the shop could deliver/hand over at the lisière (invented method). Shop located in Long Biên (Ngõ 5 Nguyễn Văn Cừ, near Bến xe Gia Lâm), 09:00-21:00; delivery stated as not announced, to be confirmed in writing (hotel handover, slot, fees). Day prices only from the owner table (scooter/semi 150 000-200 000, Vision 200 000, Air Blade 200 000, electric 'selon le modèle') with the mandatory disclaimer; no weekly/monthly derivation. Added the Hoàn Kiếm low-emission-zone pilot (from 1 July 2026; motorbikes and cars barred 19:00-midnight Fri-Sun in the lake / night-market pedestrian area; phase 1 to 31 Dec 2026; extension announced; checkpoints reported; no exception for rental bikes found) qualified as 'd'après la presse', check signs on site. Weekend-morning closure claim of the old text replaced (the old 'périmètre fermé aux moteurs en fin de semaine' was unsourced). Bridges (Long Biên two-wheelers/pedestrians only, Chương Dương) consistent with the quartiers sub-hub and flagged 'à vérifier'. No travel times, no parking prices. Parking via gửi xe described generically.

primary_intent: Inspecter sa moto de location à Hanoi avant de partir : quoi vérifier, dans quel ordre, quoi faire en cas de défaut.

new_meta.description: Pneus, freins, éclairage, klaxon, chaîne, papiers : les points à contrôler sur une moto de location à Hanoi avant de partir, et comment les noter en photos.

evidence.FACTS: Removed the assumption of a deposit ('pour votre dépôt') and the unconfirmed 'assistance' among inclusions; guarantee/inclusions now explicitly 'à confirmer avant la réservation' with the shop's phone/Zalo/WhatsApp. Removed unsourced speculation ('un loueur qui a remplacé les ampoules a probablement surveillé les plaquettes', 'plusieurs fois par kilomètre'). Added only generic mechanical checks (TWI wear marks, DOT 4-digit week/year code, chain slack, brakes) without numbers; documents: asked to see registration certificate and compulsory civil-liability insurance certificate, legal statement kept generic ('les règles vietnamiennes prévoient que le conducteur présente les papiers du véhicule') and consistent with Law 36/2024/QH15 cited in the longue-duree sub-hub; no article number or fine stated. Price: only owner range 150 000-200 000 VND/day (scooter/semi-auto) with the mandatory disclaimer. No model specs, no fleet claims.

Links to retrait (full handover), what-is-included (equipment), panne (breakdown).
